title: World Generator: Produce Qualifying Social Events at Controlled Low Frequency
objective: Make get_world_snapshot() return WorldSnapshot instances that occasionally carry a qualifying SocialEventSpec (event_type = confrontation or withdrawal) so that the existing T4 event-aware detection path (_detect_qualifying_t4_social_event) can trigger during real simulation runs. The frequency must be controlled and deterministic — same day always produces the same result.
exact_scope: Add qualifying SocialEventSpec values to a small, fixed set of existing ArcPhase definitions in back/app/world/arcs.py, and/or add a deterministic low-frequency social_event injection step in back/app/world/generator.py. Do NOT add qualifying events to every day — target approximately 2–3 qualifying days out of every 14-day arc window (roughly 15–25% frequency). Update back/tests/test_p32_t1_t4_live_audit.py to reflect the new reality: social_event is no longer always None, and T4 activation is no longer always zero. Write a new test file back/tests/test_p32_t2_generator_qualifying_events.py that verifies the new generator behavior.
constraints: AppraisalSignal v1 is frozen — do not modify any appraisal signal field definitions
SocialEventSpec schema is frozen — do not add or remove fields from the SocialEventSpec model
T4_QUALIFYING_EVENT_TYPES is frozen — only confrontation and withdrawal qualify; do not expand this set
All output must remain deterministic: same world_day must always produce the same WorldSnapshot including the same social_event value
Do not modify back/app/engines/tick_bridge.py — the T4 detection logic already exists and must not be changed
Do not modify back/app/domain/models.py or back/app/domain/enums.py
Do not touch docs/vision.md or docs/road_map.md
Social event frequency must be LOW and controlled — not every day, not random, not based on external state
Qualifying events must use event_type = SocialEventType.confrontation or SocialEventType.withdrawal
No LLM calls, no randomness, no external I/O — pure deterministic function
The T4 frozen deterministic path must not be activated through any gate manipulation — only the social-event-aware path is the approved unlock route (Phase 26B approval)
acceptance_criteria: get_world_snapshot() returns a WorldSnapshot with social_event != None on at least 2 days within the days 3–16 range (Arc 1 + Arc 2 combined)
All social_event instances produced by the real generator have event_type equal to confrontation or withdrawal
No day in the fallback ambient cycle (day 17+) produces a qualifying social event unless a specific deterministic injection rule is implemented for it
get_world_snapshot() remains fully deterministic: calling it twice for the same day always returns the same social_event value
All previously passing tests in back/tests/ continue to pass after the change (or are intentionally updated with documented justification)

test_p32_t1_t4_live_audit.py is updated: the assertions that social_event is always None and T4 activation rate is 0.0 are replaced with assertions that match the new generator behavior (social_event present on qualifying days, T4 activated on those days)

A new test file test_p32_t2_generator_qualifying_events.py is created that verifies: (1) at least one qualifying day exists in days 3–16, (2) qualifying days have social_event.event_type in {confrontation, withdrawal}, (3) non-qualifying days have social_event = None, (4) the generator is deterministic across repeated calls
required_tests: When get_world_snapshot is called for a qualifying day, the returned WorldSnapshot has a social_event with event_type equal to confrontation or withdrawal
When get_world_snapshot is called for a non-qualifying day, the returned WorldSnapshot has social_event = None
Calling get_world_snapshot for the same day twice in a row always returns the same social_event value (determinism check)
The total count of qualifying days in days 3 through 16 is at least 2 and no more than 5

Running a 10-day live simulation using simulate_day_bridged with the real generator produces T4 activation on the qualifying days (T4ActivationAuditRecord.activated = True when world.social_event is a qualifying event)
The T4 activation rate across a 14-day live run (days 3–16) is greater than 0.0 and less than or equal to 0.40 (controlled frequency upper bound)
non_goals: Do not implement routing or filtering of social events by target_id at T4
Do not add social events to the fallback ambient cycle (day 17+) unless explicitly scoped
Do not redesign the social event taxonomy or add new SocialEventType values
Do not change settlement logic, residual creation logic, or appraisal output logic
Do not implement relational residual carry for T4 (that is a separate downstream task in P32)
Do not make T4 produce residuals — only make the qualifying event detectable
Do not add qualifying events to every arc day or make frequency high
Do not change the ArcPhase dataclass structure
